items.text: Mike Evans (SF) has Achilles tendinitis that flared up Monday night, and Kyle Shanahan said it is not a long-term problem. NBC Sports Bay Area reports the Achilles is intact but San Francisco is bracing for him to miss @ATL, with the bye in Week 8. He is WR26 rest of season for me. Monitor; San Francisco's Wednesday practice report.

Terry McLaurin (WAS) has his left knee scanned Tuesday after being carted off @SF, and Ian Rapoport reports Washington is bracing for a season-ending injury. Washington is on bye in Week 7, so nobody loses a lineup spot yet. Monitor; Washington's MRI result Tuesday, and a season-ending diagnosis makes him a drop.

Baker Mayfield (TB) is set to practice Wednesday on the dislocated right thumb, but Fox Sports' Greg Auman reports Todd Bowles is still planning for Jalon Daniels to make a fourth straight start @CAR. Mayfield is QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Tampa Bay's Wednesday practice report.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) was expected to do some running Tuesday on the ankle, per Mike LaFleur, after missing Week 6 @LAR, where Bam Knight ran 15 times for 80. Love is RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor; Arizona's Wednesday practice report before @DEN.
